note: Recorded before any E1b outcome was computed. A file belongs to the root with the longest matching segment prefix ('*' = any one segment; '.' = repo root, always last resort). Area id = '<expanded root>/<up to 2 path components of the file's directory below the root>' (root itself when the file lies directly in the root). Eligible files, bulk rule and exclusion globs come from evaluation/inertia-v1/exclusions.json.
